acceptance_evidence: Stage 5B raises high-demand recall at all horizons and reduces peak-magnitude error at 72h and 168h, but WAPE, MAE, RMSE, and period-energy error are materially worse at every horizon; peak overlap is lower at every horizon, and high-demand F1 is lower at 72h and 168h. The candidate therefore does not justify replacement of any frozen Stage 5 selection.
